summary: I have the pink dye and can’t end the session, while Jill has no items, no action restrictions, and shares the goal; together we’ll obtain white wool and dye it to craft pink wool.
Jill finds and kills a sheep to obtain white wool, brings it to Andy, and Andy uses his pink dye to craft pink wool.
